commanders.name: Ada
commanders.description: A steady captain: infantry stand firm, and her rally heals and hits harder.

powers.name: Rally
powers.description: Heals every unit 5 and gives +3 Strength until your next turn.

powers.name: Surge
powers.description: Every unit may act again and moves 1 farther for two turns. Costs 50% more each use.

commanders.name: Bram
commanders.description: Fast but brittle heavies; his storm hurts every enemy and brings gold.

powers.name: Storm
powers.description: Hurts every enemy 4 (never defeats) and brings 25 gold.

commanders.name: Cato
commanders.description: Slow to anger: the meter fills from blows taken.
